nodes.title: Foundation Phase
nodes.description: Foundation Phase (Grades R-3)

nodes.title: Grade 2
nodes.description: Grade 2

nodes.title: English Home Language
nodes.description: English Home Language for Grade 2 — Foundation Phase CAPS. Skills: Listening and Speaking, Phonics, Reading (Shared/Group Guided/Independent), Writing, Handwriting. Note: Term 3 ATP not available; Terms 1, 2 and 4 are included.

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Grade 2 English HL Term 1 (45 days; 3-day baseline period in Weeks 1-2)

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Classifies information; answers questions about stories; personal experiences; makes suggestions to problems; participates in discussions; increasing vocabulary

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: Sound families (short vowels -at, -ag, -am, -it); revise word families; consonant digraphs (sh, ch, th); vowel digraphs; builds 3-4 letter words; learns to spell 10 words per week

nodes.title: Reading — Shared, Group Guided and Independent
nodes.description: Shared Reading: cover/pictures to predict; cause and effect; personal response; concepts of print; phonics; comprehension at range of levels; Group Guided: sight vocabulary, phonics, structural analysis, self-monitoring; Independent: reads to partner for fluency

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Shared, Group Guided, Independent Reading

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: Draws pictures; contributes ideas and words for class story; at least 3 sentences own news; uses capital letters; uses comma with lists; shared writing

metadata.capsReference: Writing: class story, own news, punctuation

nodes.title: Handwriting
nodes.description: Book and page position; lower case letters correctly formed; directionality, formation and spacing; aligns on lined paper

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Grade 2 English HL Term 2 (49 days)

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Listens to stories for longer periods; identifies similarities and differences; makes own rhymes; listens to more complex instructions; participates in discussions; retells stories

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: 3-letter consonant blends (str-ip, str-ap); vowel digraphs ('oa' as in boat, 'ea' as in eat, 'ai' as in train); silent e/split digraph (tape, time, note); builds 3-5 letter words; learns 10 words per week

metadata.capsReference: Phonics: consonant blends, vowel digraphs, split digraph

nodes.title: Reading — Shared, Group Guided and Independent
nodes.description: Shared Reading: cause and effect; key details; higher-order questions; different text formats; Group Guided: structural analysis, self-monitoring, fluency, comprehension, punctuation; Independent: partner reading, comics and fiction books

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Shared, Group Guided, Independent Reading

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: Paragraph of at least 5 sentences; personal experiences and daily news; topic discussion; writing process; expressive texts (thank you card, letter); own story of at least one paragraph; capital letters, full stops, question marks; uses prepositions; present and past tenses

nodes.title: Handwriting
nodes.description: Print script in all capitals and lower case; correct spacing; aligns on 17mm ruled lines; copies and writes different formats (birthday invitations, messages, lists)

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Grade 2 English HL Term 4 (49 days). Note: Term 3 ATP was not available.

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Personal experiences and general news; descriptive language; uses language terms (noun, adjective, verb, pronoun, comma, question mark, paragraph); jokes and riddles; follows complex sequence of instructions

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: New vowel digraphs, diphthongs and blends; vowel digraphs (ar, oa, oe, ow); suffixes (-ly, -ies); revises plurals (s and es); reads from phonics lessons; builds words using phonics sounds taught

nodes.title: Reading — Shared, Group Guided and Independent
nodes.description: Shared Reading: fiction and non-fiction; sequence of events; identifying problem; apostrophes in contractions; Group Guided: fluency, phonics/structural analysis, self-correcting, increasing speed; Independent: reading games, crosswords, variety of texts

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Shared, Group Guided, Independent Reading

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: 1-2 paragraphs on personal experiences; organises info in chart/table; drafts and publishes own story; sequences text; spells common words; uses punctuation; present/past/future tenses; recipe framework; builds word bank

nodes.title: Handwriting
nodes.description: Begin transition from print script to joined script/cursive; consistent letter formation; increasing writing speed while maintaining neatness
